text:
Mira Chen: Quick follow-up from the OOM postmortem — want to lock owners and timelines for the shard-cache leak + fragmentation work. TL;DR: frequent small OOM spikes, root cause looks like per-shard KV slab fragmentation + a rare path that rebinds large chunks without freeing.
Samir Patel: I can take ownership of the profiling and reproducer. Plan: nightly heapshot + allocation flamegraphs, and a small micro-repro harness to exercise shard churn.
Rajiv Kapoor: I'll own the runtime mitigations (GC/eviction) and rollout. Proposal: add per-shard soft-cap + background compaction and a fast-path evict when resident > 90%.
Tom B.: I'll do the alerting/observability pieces — add a dashboard for per-shard RSS, fragmentation ratio, and count of reclaimed pages. Also set an alert at 85% per-host.
Mira Chen: Concrete action items:
  - Samir: repro + profiling job (ETA 3 days)
  - Rajiv: implement soft-cap + compaction job (ETA 2 weeks)
  - Tom: dashboards and alerts (ETA 4 days)
  - Ops-bot: run canary with compaction off by default, enable on 5% of traffic (post-PR)
Samir Patel: Notes for profiling: use heaptrack + jemalloc-stats and a sequence of churned put/delete cycles. I put a starter script in the perf repo:
```
# run 30s churn across 50 shards
./perf/churn_runner --shards=50 --put-rt=20 --del-rt=5 --duration=30
# collect jemalloc stats per proc
curl http://localhost:9100/debug/je_malloc_stats > /tmp/je_stats.json
```
Rajiv Kapoor: For compaction, trying two approaches:
  1) background page-scan + migrate live objects (safe, slower)
  2) slab-coalesce heuristics on low-util slabs (risky but faster)
I'll PR 1 first. Also thinking about an opt-in jemalloc arena purge for low-pressure hosts.
Tom B.: Dashboard panels: per-shard resident, per-shard active_bytes, fragmentation_ratio=(active/allocated), and GC-run-count. Alert -> slack #eng-runtime and page at 10%+ host-level growth in 10m.
Mira Chen: Rollout plan: dev -> canary (5%) -> ramp (25%, 60%) if metrics stable for 2h each stage. Fallback: disable compaction and revert soft-cap to previous limits.
Samir Patel: Found one suspicious codepath where we allocate a transient 'snapshot' of keys and forget to free on early return. I'll add a sanitising test and a leak-check in CI.
Rajiv Kapoor: Also adding a per-shard hard OOM guard: if resident > hard_limit -> reject new writes with 429 and log detailed snapshot (owner: runtime team).
Tom B.: I'll add log parsing to extract the 429 events and tie them to shard_id and host so we can correlate with fragmentation spikes.
Mira Chen: Dependencies and risks: compaction increases CPU; need perf budget in Dedicated pools. Samir, can your profiling capture CPU vs compaction benefit ballpark numbers?
Samir Patel: Yes — profiling will include wall/CPU and estimate time-to-compact per-MB. I'll attach numbers to PR.
incident-bot: Incident #2026-03-18-12 closed by Mira Chen. Root cause tagged: shard-cache fragmentation + allocation leak.
ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled after PR merge. Will notify #eng-runtime when canary begins. :eyes:
Rajiv Kapoor: Follow-up weekly check-ins for recurring pattern: every Monday 10am for next 6 weeks to track regressions and telemetry. I'll own the calendar invites.
Mira Chen: Thanks all. Please update the postmortem doc with your PR links and change the status to 'in-progress' once your task starts. I'll triage blockers in the Monday check-ins.
Tom B.: Done — created dashboard draft and linked it in the postmortem doc (commented). Willn’t enable paging until we see stable metrics in canary.
Samir Patel: PR for repro infra opened: perf/repro/1832500000-shard-churn. Attaching initial flamegraph in the postmortem comments.
Rajiv Kapoor: PR queued for compaction prototype, request review from Mira and Samir.
Mira Chen: Marking owners pinned. Next update in thread with timestamps. Good work, team. :tada:
